# Detect pg_cron client and Postgres container (read-only)
command -v psql
command -v docker
docker ps --filter name=supabase-db --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'
docker inspect supabase-db --format '{{.State.Running}}'

# List pg_cron jobs
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT jobid, jobname, schedule, command, active, database, username FROM cron.job ORDER BY jobid;"

# Recent run history (failed/paused detection)
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT runid, jobid, command, status, return_message, start_time, end_time FROM cron.job_run_details ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 50;"

# pg_cron settings and extension version
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT name, setting, source FROM pg_settings WHERE name LIKE 'cron%';"
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron';"

# Inspect config files (no .env, no secrets)
grep -E '^cron\.' /etc/supabase/config.toml
awk '/cron/' /etc/supabase/config.toml
sed -n '1,40p' /etc/supabase/docker-compose.yml
find /etc/supabase -name 'config.toml' -type f
